concepts.proposed_markdown: Bearer-authenticated `GET /v1/planDetails/{plan_id}/customers` lists customer-and-Plan detail pairs for one UUID-identified legacy Plan. Optional `status` defaults to `active`, supports `all`, `active`, `ended`, and `upcoming`, permits comma-separated OR selections, and does not yet support `ended,upcoming`; optional cursor pagination accompanies required top-level `data` plus nullable `next_page`. Metronome marks the endpoint as deprecated and directs new clients to Contracts, but this page names no replacement Contracts operation or Plan-to-Contract identity or field mapping. [[source-metronome-api-reference-plans-list-customers-on-a-plan]]
warnings: The raw page directs new clients to Contracts but does not identify an equivalent Contracts route or migration mapping.
